body.statement: Under the selected four-response-type factorization in Condition 1, positive observed conditional probabilities, and Conditions 2--3 of Shingaki--Yoshida--Kuroki (2026), Theorem 1 identifies PN and PS; the Appendix derivation (A.28)--(A.33), reported as equations (16)--(19) in the paper, gives their observable plug-in formulas.

source.locator: Theorem 1, Conditions 1--3, pages 3514--3515; Appendix equations (A.28)--(A.33), reported as equations (16)--(19) on pages 3516--3517
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1 shows that both the PN and the PS are identifiable under Conditions 1, 2, and 3. Thus, from equations (A.33) in Appendix A, the consistent estimators of p(Y_x=y given x-prime,y-prime) are given by equation (19).

attestation.note: Exact prose transcribed from the PMLR publisher PDF at pp. 3515 and 3517; symbolic arguments rendered in plain text while retaining the source wording.
